Subject: Post-discovery: book 30min demo + stakeholder priority matrix

Hi Amit / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: NovaCore is prioritizing lower-latency inference for interactive search, predictable cost per 1k requests, and having an audit-ready control plane for downstream audits.

Next step: a short 30-minute product walkthrough (no heavy ops/setup) to show the runtime, routing/fallback behavior, and the cost controls we discussed. Can you please pick one of the 3 windows below (all PT):

- Tue May 20 — 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed May 21 — 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu May 22 — 08:30–09:00 PT

Please indicate which stakeholders would join (engineering, security, procurement). If helpful, I attached a draft mutual action plan to accelerate procurement. Also included a short matrix below — if you can mark priority (1–3) that helps me tailor the runbook:

Priority matrix (please reply inline):
- Latency / P99 targets: ___
- Throughput & burst sizing: ___
- Data residency & audit logs: ___
- Cost per 1k tokens / budget constraints: ___

Links / attachments: NovaCore_MAP_draft.xlsx (attached); calendar link will be shared once we lock time.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate SMEs once you confirm a window.

Soojin Lee

soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Soojin —

Appreciate the recap. Wed May 21 14:00 PT works best for our engineering lead. Thu May 22 at 08:30 is my backup.

On stakeholders:
- Engineering (I'll invite Raj, our infra lead)
- Security: would it make sense to include our security architect (Anika) on the call? She usually needs to confirm audit/logging posture early.
- Procurement: I'll loop in procurement if we land on a time.

Priority quick answers:
- Latency / P99 targets: 150–200ms desired (search front-end)
- Throughput & burst sizing: variable; likely 3–4k reqs/min during peak tests
- Data residency & audit logs: must preserve audit trails for 12 months
- Cost per 1k tokens: TBD — need to see unit economics in the demo

Thanks — will await your calendar invite.

—Amit
